# Fix My AI Rank

> Fix My AI Rank helps B2B companies get cited in AI-generated answers (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Claude) through entity signal audits, schema markup fixes, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) / Answer Engine Optimization (AEO).

Fix My AI Rank is built and operated by TangySlice Collective, a B2B marketing agency. The site offers free, automated AI visibility reports plus paid GEO/AEO services for companies that rank well on Google but are missing from AI-generated answers.

## Reports

- [AI Visibility Report](https://fixmyairank.com/): Free report benchmarking a company's entity signals, content gaps, and schema markup against its top competitors.
- [Entity and Contribution Report](https://fixmyairank.com/entity-report/): Identifies third-party signal gaps (Wikipedia, Wikidata, G2, Crunchbase, etc.) that cause AI systems to recommend competitors first.
- [Local AI Visibility Report](https://fixmyairank.com/local-visibility-report/): Audits how ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Claude see a local business and what to fix first.
- [Page Optimization Report](https://fixmyairank.com/page-optimization-report/): Full GEO and SEO audit of a single URL with copy-paste schema fixes and a prioritized checklist.
- [Local AI Visibility Report for Plastic Surgery Practices](https://fixmyairank.com/plastic-surgery-ai-visibility-report/): Industry-specific version of the local visibility report for cosmetic surgery practices.
